key_insight: Learning interactions between organic and inorganic substructures improves band-gap prediction for hybrid solar cell materials.
engineering_relevance: More accurate band-gap predictions could support computational screening of hybrid materials for solar cells.
method: Represent complex chemical systems with a descriptor for heterogeneous substructures.
Use a graph neural network to learn organic–inorganic inter-graph interactions.
Predict band gaps of hybrid solar cell materials.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art band-gap prediction accuracy on 1,682 hybrid solar cell materials, without specifying error metrics or evaluation splits.
watch_item: Generalization to new chemical families and improved solar-cell performance are not established by the abstract.
paper_title: Learning Inter-Graph Interactions Between Heterogeneous Substructures of Chemical Systems
